name: Eagle of the East 2018

venue.name: [Baku Engineering University](http://www.beu.edu.az/)
venue.address: Xırdalan şəh, Həsən Əliyev küç, 120 AZ0101, Abşeron, Baku, Azerbaijan

information: Welcome once again to Baku – largest city in Caucasus, beautifully situated by the eagle-like east part of Azerbaijan! Eagle of the East 2018 is a friendly and relaxed cube competition open to all who wish to participate. It is currently one of the largest competitions in South Caucasus and we are hoping for many participants also this year.
